title: Applied ML Weekly Notes - 2026-07-14
content:
---
Meeting: Applied ML weekly sync
Date: 2026-07-14
Attendees: Aisha Patel (notes), Miguel Santos, Claire Wong, Ben Carter, Priya Kapoor (opt-in)
---

TL;DR
- Continued progress on 4-bit quantization (AWQ/q4_k_m) for Llama-2-70B variant; latency down ~2.3x in p50; some accuracy degradation on instruction-following evals (~0.9% BLEU-equivalent drop, +1.6% hallucination rate on internal hallucination suite)
- Eval harness updated to include new 'instruction-robustness' suite; nightly runs now flag regressions and post-rollout alerts
- Model onboarding checklist refined (tokenizer checks, KV cache validation, kernel flags); onboarding of internal finetuned-7B in progress

Updates (by area)

Quantization
- Miguel: ran AWQ 4-bit experiments on llm-70b-v2/finetuned variants. Setup: AWQ q4_k_m with group size 128, recompute scale+zero. Observations:
  - Inference throughput (dedicated GPU pool, A100-80GB): p50 latency reduced from 320ms->140ms (2.28x), throughput +2.1x in steady-state batching
  - Top-1 instruction-following accuracy drop: 0.9% absolute on internal MMLU-style instruction set; small but consistent across seeds
  - Hallucination check (hallucination-suite-v2): +1.6% false-fact hallucination rate vs FP16 baseline
  - Memory footprint: model fits on single 80GB with room for cache; KV cache memory similar to baseline due to cache storing full-precision activations
- Action: Run AWQ with group size 64 and fine-tune LLM adapter to recover instruction-following. Owner: Miguel. Due: 2026-07-21.
- Note: AWQ conversion pipeline occasionally produces minor tokenizer offsets when using merged-tokenizer configs; Claire to open PR to normalize token offsets during conversion (PR linked below).

Evals & Regression Monitoring
- Claire: merged 'instruction-robustness' suite into nightly harness. Suite contains 12 targeted scenarios (chain-of-thought, API-instruction-mismatch, prompt-truncation edgecases).
  - Nightly run results: 3 regressions flagged (AWQ q4_k_m on llm-70b-v2), minor severity. Alerts created in Linear RD-1198.
  - Implemented threshold-based alerting: regress if metric drops >1.0% absolute OR hallucination increases >1.0% absolute.
- Ben: ran A/B eval for dedicated vs hosted variants on 1000 user-like prompts.
  - Latency: hosted p95 spikes @ 1.8s under load; dedicated stays ~420ms.
  - Quality parity: small diff; dedicated with AWQ shows slight quality reduction.
- Action: Add more adversarial prompts to the hallucination-suite and expand coverage for API-tool-calling tests. Owner: Claire. Due: 2026-07-28.

Model Onboarding
- Onboarding checklist updated (new canonical steps):
  1) Model artifact validation (sha256, manifest)
  2) Tokenizer sanity tests (vocab overlap, offsets)
  3) KV-cache dry-run (10-step forward with cache integrity checks)
  4) Quantized variant smoke (compare logits distribution vs FP16, KL-divergence threshold)
  5) Eval harness baseline (100-shot instruction set)
  6) Perf profiling (p50, p95, memory)
  7) Rollout plan (canary, metrics to monitor, rollback triggers)
- Priya has started onboarding finetuned-7B-internal. Roadblocks: conversion from HF safetensors -> internal artifact format drops dtype metadata; workaround: explicit dtype metadata injection script (WIP).
- Action: Add a mandatory 'logit-distribution' sanity check to onboarding. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2026-07-18.

Infrastructure/Serving Notes
- Serving runtime: small change to kernel selection heuristics merged; selects alternative fused-attention kernel when seq_len <= 1024 and batch_size >= 8. Expected to reduce tail latency for short prompt workloads.
- Observability: added token-level cost breakdown for quantized models in console (beta). Dashboard card: model/llm-70b-v2/quantized-4bit now shows token-cost-adjusted QPS.

Risks & Open Questions
- Tradeoff between throughput and instruction-following quality: how much degradation is acceptable for cost savings? Need product input for SLO tradeoffs on hosted tier.
- Are some instruction types disproportionately affected by AWQ? Early signal: multi-step reasoning prompts have larger drops.
- Onboarding friction: artifact metadata loss in format conversions. Consider adding an artifact-preservation spec to model registry.

Decisions
- Short-term: proceed with AWQ experiments + adapter fine-tuning to recover quality; keep AWQ models in 'experimental' catalog only. Decision owner: Aisha.
- Medium-term: add quantified rollback triggers in rollout config (KL-divergence > 0.03 or hallucination delta > 1.0%).

Action Items (summary)
- Miguel: Run AWQ group-size-64 + adapter tune (due 2026-07-21)
- Claire: Normalize tokenizer offsets in conversion pipeline (open PR) & expand hallucination-suite (due 2026-07-28)
- Aisha: Add logit-distribution sanity check to onboarding checklist (due 2026-07-18)
- Priya: Continue finetuned-7B onboarding; finalize dtype-metadata injection script (due 2026-07-20)
- Ben: Flesh out A/B eval report and include cost-per-token breakdown (due 2026-07-22)

Links & Artifacts
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rv-inference/pull/842 (AWQ conversion fixes) 
- Linear: RD-1198 (regressions: instruction-robustness)
- Confluence draft: /display/AM/Model+Onboarding+Checklist (draft)
- Eval harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/compare/feature/instruction-robustness

Notes to self / loose thoughts
- Consider a 'gradual quantization' rollout: start with low-risk prompts and slowly expand coverage while monitoring hallucination signals.
- Could we run small-scale human eval on targeted instruction types to better measure perceptual quality impact vs automated metrics?

Next meeting: 2026-07-21 10:00am PT (Applied ML weekly)
